answer: Each identity must pass a quartz-timed behavioral fingerprint: over 10 epochs, peers record its unique response-time and service-pattern signature on a public trellis of signed observations. A newcomer trades only inside a small oasis of 5 vetted partners until its signature proves distinct from every existing identity. Clones share one signature, so 100 fakes collapse into a single throttled identity capped at 3 trades per epoch; forging a fresh signature costs 200 units of locked bond plus 10 epochs of real service, and a mismatch forfeits the bond.
